name: browser-render
description: Headless-Chromium (Puppeteer) renderer. Connects out to the platform's existing /ws gateway as a control client and, per session, as a live-stream publisher — no HTTP API of its own beyond a health check. See apps/api/src/ws/gateway.ts (BROWSER_* messages) and packages/ui/src/browser-session/use-browser-session.ts.
